name: disposable account deletion proof checklist / operator proof package
operator_checklist: Create or choose a disposable test account.
Generate or reuse normal model audio.
If needed, run /setup/voice to create normal v1 voice data.
Optionally save a model audio or best take pin if saved pin coverage is required.
Confirm the request by typing DELETE.
Capture inventory dry-run, job stage dry-run, provider cleanup dry-run, Storage cleanup dry-run, DB cleanup dry-run, and Auth deletion dry-run safe summaries.
actual_deletion_blockers_before_executio: DB schema / migration sufficiency for request tracking and anonymized completion tracking
Request tracking survives Auth user deletion without private identifiers
Destructive execution surface is scoped and operator-only
Supabase Auth user deletion runs last
Storage cleanup runs after provider cleanup and before DB/Auth cleanup
DB cleanup / anonymization runs after Storage cleanup
Provider cleanup can delete or safely mark normal v1 voice resources as not applicable
Post-delete verification can prove absence or safe anonymized retention
Proof package can be generated without raw user data or secrets
not_changed: App Store or Google Play submission

result_criteria.PASS: Disposable account data exists, request and confirmation work, dry-run summaries cover all v1 categories, redaction passes, and the stop point is before actual deletion.
result_criteria.WARN: Dry-run works but some counts are zero, optional normal voice data is absent, or human confirmation remains before actual deletion proof.
result_criteria.BLOCKED: Request cannot be created/confirmed, dry-run cannot load, a required boundary is unavailable, or the proof package cannot be made safely.
result_criteria.FAIL: Secret, raw provider response, transcript body, private audio path, storage object key, provider voice id, raw account identifier, or private user data is recorded.

human_required: Confirmation that support URL / privacy URL / deletion URL are Store-ready
Provider cleanup semantics for normal v1 voice resources
Final legal approval for account deletion copy and proof language
